name: 9-Max & 6-Max Table Seat Position GTO RFI, 3-Bet, Fold-to-3-Bet & Winrate Benchmarks (2026)
description: Quantitative 100BB cash game positional solver benchmark covering all 9 canonical poker table seats (UTG, UTG+1, MP, LJ, HJ, CO, BTN, SB, BB) with Raise-First-In (RFI) %, 3-Bet %, Fold-to-3-Bet %, Cold-Call %, and expected BB/100 winrates.

rows.core_strategy: Open Raise 2.2x To 2.5x Online Or 3x To 4x In Live Cash Games With A Strictly Linear Value-Heavy Range Plus Select Suited Wheel Aces (A5s And A4s) For Board Coverage And 4-Bet Bluffs. Eliminate All Open-Limping And Avoid Offsuit Broadways Below AQo That Suffer Reverse Implied Odds Out Of Position.
rows.postflop_advantage: Although UTG Frequently Acts Out Of Position Against Late-Position Callers, It Carries The Strongest Uncapped Range Advantage On Ace-High, King-High, And Queen-High Boards, Enabling High-Frequency Small Range Continuation Bets (25% To 33% Pot).
rows.top_playable_hands: AA KK QQ AKs AQs A5s

rows.core_strategy: When UTG Folds, Open 12.2% Of Hands By Adding Mid-Tier Suited Connectors (98s, 87s), Additional Suited Aces (A3s, A2s), And Pocket Sixes/Fives at Higher Frequency. When Facing A UTG Open, Play A Pure 3-Bet Or Fold Strategy At 100BB To Avoid Getting Squeezed By Seven Remaining Players.
rows.postflop_advantage: Like UTG, UTG+1 Retains A Substantial Nut Advantage On Broadway-Heavy Textures And Can Leverage Polarized Turn Overbets When Flop Continuation Bets Are Called By Late-Position Defenders.
rows.top_playable_hands: AA JJ AKs KQs JTs A4s

rows.core_strategy: Open Raise 14.5% Of Hands When Folded To You, Including All Pocket Pairs Down To 44, All Suited Aces (A2s Through AKs), Suited Broadways, And Suited Connectors Down To 76s. Against Early Position Opens, Prioritize 3-Betting Linearly With QQ+, AK, AQs, And KQs.
rows.postflop_advantage: MP Enjoys Positional Superiority Over The Blinds And Early Position While Retaining Strong Broadway And Mid-Pair Board Coverage, Allowing Balanced Check-Range And Bet-Range Splits.
rows.top_playable_hands: QQ TT AQs AJs QJs T9s

rows.core_strategy: Open 2.2x To 2.5x With 17.5% Of Hands: All Pocket Pairs (22 Through AA), All Suited Aces (A2s+), Suited Kings Down To K8s, Suited Queens Down To Q9s, Suited Connectors Down To 65s, And Offsuit Broadways ATo+ And KQo. Defend Carefully Against Hijack, Cutoff, And Button 3-Bets.
rows.postflop_advantage: The Lojack Commands Strong Top-Of-Range Equity Against Big Blind Defenders On High-Card Flops While Maintaining Better Mid-Board Coverage (6-5-4 And 8-7-6) Than Early Full-Ring Seats.

rows.core_strategy: Open Raise 21.5% Of Hands When Folded To You, Expanding Into Suited Kings (K6s+), Suited Queens (Q8s+), Suited Gappers (T8s, 97s, 86s), And Offsuit Broadways (KJo, QJo, ATo). Actively 3-Bet Isolate Lojack And Middle Position Opens With A Linear-Plus-Suited-Blocker Range.
rows.postflop_advantage: The Hijack Acts In Position Against The Blinds And Early Openers In 80%+ Of Postflop Spots, Allowing Aggressive Turn Barreling And Delayed Continuation Betting When Checked To.

rows.core_strategy: Open Raise 28.0% Of Hands When Folded To You, Adding All Suited Kings (K2s+), Suited Queens (Q5s+), Suited Jacks (J7s+), Offsuit Aces (A8o+), And Suited Gappers. When An Early Or Hijack Player Opens, Frequently 3-Bet To Force The Button To Fold And "Buy The Button" For Postflop Play.
rows.postflop_advantage: Whenever The Button Folds, The Cutoff Becomes The Effective Dealer For The Rest Of The Hand, Acting Last On Flop, Turn, And River Against Both Blinds.

rows.core_strategy: Open Raise 2.0x To 2.5x With 44.5% Of Hands When Folded To You, Attacking The Small And Big Blinds With All Pocket Pairs, All Suited Aces, All Suited Kings, Suited Queens (Q2s+), Suited Jacks (J4s+), Offsuit Aces (A2o+), And Wide Suited Connectors. 3-Bet Cutoff And Hijack Opens At 11.8% Frequency.
rows.postflop_advantage: Acting Last On Every Postflop Street Gives The Button Maximum Information, Superior Equity Realization (Often 110%+ Of Raw Equity), Effective Float Opportunities, And Complete Control Over Pot Size.

rows.core_strategy: Against Any Open Raise From UTG Through The Button, Eliminate Flat-Calling Almost Entirely In Raked Cash Games And Play A Linear 13.5% 3-Bet Range Sized At 3.5x To 4.0x The Open. When Folded To You In Blind-Vs-Blind (BvB), Raise 3.0x Or Mix Limps And Raises Across 41.0% Of Hands.
rows.postflop_advantage: While The Small Blind Suffers A Positional Disadvantage Postflop, Its 3-Bet Range Is Highly Concentrated With Broadway Cards And Overpairs, Allowing Aggressive Flop C-Betting And Turn Barreling In 3-Bet Pots.
rows.top_playable_hands: KK TT AKs AQs A5s KQs

rows.core_strategy: Leverage Your 1BB Discount And Closing Preflop Action To Defend Wide Against Small 2.0x To 2.5x Opens (Up To 55% Total Defense Against A Button 2.2x Open, Split Between 12% Polarized 3-Bets And 43% Calls). Tighten Dramatically Against 3x To 5x Live Opens And Multiway Pots.
rows.postflop_advantage: On Low Connected, Paired, And Two-Tone Boards (Such As 8-6-5, 7-4-4, And 9-7-6), The Big Blind Holds The Nut Advantage (More Straight And Two-Pair Combinations Than An Early Opener), Fueling High-Frequency Flop Check-Raises And Turn Leads.
